verdict.rationale: The published pages show a front-page Schnellsuche by company name or EUID, a register identifier that works as a file-number-style entry. The supplementary note states that register search and announcements are public, so the core retrieval flow can start without an account. However, no page explicitly says no login is required, and the filing/publication path (Publikations-Plattform) is not documented as keyless. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no account or registration is needed, documentation of the entry path for filing or publication orders, and hands-on confirmation of anonymous access.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path

citations.quote: register search and announcements are public
